name: Ero Coach! ~Sukumizu Bishoujo Miori × Dekamara Shidou~
original_name: エロこーち! ～スク水美少女・澪莉×デカマラ指導～
source:
I'm Gouda Onoue, and yeah, I'm the PE teacher for Seisho Gakuen and a pervert. 

Miori Sonohara is a student in my class I've been 
trying to get with for a while, but to no avail. 

It was finally at summer vacation 
I found out Miori doesn't know how to swim, which is my chance. 

I'm mounting a plan to mount that pretty loli. 

Come along, Miori-chan. Let's have a private swim lesson.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE093910.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
我是刚田尾上，是的，我是圣翔学园的体育老师，也是个变态。

园原美织是我班的学生 
试图相处一段时间，但无济于事。

终于到了暑假 
我发现美织不会游泳，这是我的机会。

我正在制定一个计划来安装那个漂亮的萝莉。

Come along, Miori-chan.我们来上私人游泳课吧。
